_doc: Endgame Phase 1A: the Atlas of Ruin (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Hex map in axial coords (q, r); the hub is the centre hex (ring 0). Each ring is one painting layer. A hex's biome, boss, vantage flag and base modifiers derive from hash(atlas_seed, q, r); only revealed hexes and clear counts are saved (character save key 'atlas'). Ring stats replace the biome zone def's tier scaling. Phase 3A: radius 6 (127 hexes); rings 4-6 (Underpainting, Drawing, Bare Canvas) at levels 55/60/65 (affix tier 7 rolls from item level 55). A ring's optional `ambient_tint` blends into the biome's ambient light by `ambient_tint_w` (rings 1-3 have none, so they look as before).
unlock_text: Defeat Malgrath in the Nightmare Vaults (Tier 5)

rot._doc: Endgame Phase 1C: Rot, the spreading decay (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Per-hex level 0-5, saved as atlas.rot {key: level}. A new atlas plants `sources` hexes at Rot `source_level` in rings >= min_ring. Each completed zone advances `fronts` (+1 per festered Heart since the last spread): a front adds +1 to the not-restored hex in rings >= min_ring that is a Rot hex or next to one, picked by a seeded score, while total Rot < cap_per_ring x rings revealed. Restored hexes never take Rot. Phase 3A: Rot (sources, fronts, loaded state) only reaches rings up to max(reach_ring, the highest revealed ring), so an atlas whose player is still in rings 1-3 plays exactly as the radius-3 atlas did; the cap (cap_per_ring x highest revealed ring) grows to 18 at ring 6. Death in a zone adds +1 to that hex. Phase 3B (Dan, 2026-11-11): when ring 4, 5 or 6 is first revealed it gets `ring_sources` extra seeded Rot source(s) at source_level (seeded by atlas seed + ring, recorded in atlas.ring_sources so never planted twice). levels[n-1] = the zone scaling at Rot n (heal = player life recovery multiplier, attack_speed = monster attack speed; Phase 1E tuning; move_speed = monster movement, proj_speed = monster projectile speed: Phase D2, the levers that reach kiting builds). Phase D2 dial (typical bots, docs/PHASE_D2_MEASUREMENTS.md): ~85% wins at Rot 3, ~65% at Rot 4 + 2 Pigments, ~45% at Rot 5 + 2 Pigments.

heart._doc: At Rot >= heart_at the hex boss is the Heart of Rot: rot_mutations from its enemies.json entry (seeded order per hex), phase thresholds moved up by phase_shift, extra life.

harvest._doc: Harvest (fester) payout per Rot level n: a guaranteed legendary, gold = monster level x gold_per_level x n, n x material_rolls materials, (n - 2) gems, n - 2 extra rares. The hex keeps its Rot and the next spread gets +1 front.

mechanics._doc: Endgame Phase 1D zone mechanics (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Each Atlas run rolls one natural mechanic at natural_chance, seeded by (atlas seed, hex, clear count), so the panel shows the next run's mechanic. Pigments (1E) will guarantee one.

list.name: Glazed Elites
list.desc: Elites wear layers of glaze, one per modifier. Each poise break peels the outer layer: the modifier is gone and a Glaze Flake drops.

list.name: The Unfinished
list.desc: Some packs are only sketches: immune until painted with the status colours on their outline (or slowly by any hits). Painted sketches drop loot as one rank higher and Pigment Dust.

list.name: Burning Canvas
list.desc: The painting catches fire at the entrance and the burn chases you to the arena. Burnt floor scorches you and burns common and magic loot and gold; kills just ahead of the front drop Ash. Cisterns push the fire back.

list.name: Pigment Wells
list.desc: Crimson, ochre and verdigris wells hide in the chambers. Kills near a well (and standing by it) fill it, but a filling well strengthens the monsters around it. Mix them at the easel after the boss: the ratio picks the reward chest.

list.name: The Collector's Wager
list.desc: A gaunt art collector waits mid-zone and offers 3 bets on your own play. Stake gold at 1x, 2x or 3x; a win pays the stake back with profit plus materials, a loss costs only the stake.

list.name: Pentimento Vaults
list.desc: Shimmering walls hide painted-over rooms. Damage the wall to scrape it away; its plaque tells you first whether it holds Treasure, a Trap (elite ambush, double loot) or a Riddle (strike the sigils in order).

mechanics.minor_doc: Endgame Phase 2D: 'minor' mechanics (wager, vault) never take the main natural roll; each rolls on its own at `chance` (x the Atelier's natural_mult, x its vault_mult / wager_mult), seeded by (atlas seed, hex, clear count), so a zone can have Glazed/Unfinished plus a Wager and Vaults.

glazed._doc: elite_chance_mult on the zone's elite chance; every elite is glazed with layers = its modifiers, raised to min_layers (extra random modifiers) and capped at max_layers. Burst poise: a hit adds damage / max life / fill_fraction x 100 (big hits up to big_hit_multiplier); a stun or freeze adds stun_poise; the bar drains decay_per_sec all the time, so only fast damage or frequent stuns fill it. 100 = peel the outer layer (1 Flake), then stagger s and peel_immunity s of poise immunity. On death the remaining layers shatter into Flakes: all if killed within shatter_fast s of the first hit, none after shatter_slow s, linear between. Every layer gone (peeled + shattered): +full_bonus Flakes, +1 per 2 Rot, +full_rarity_bonus rarity.

unfinished._doc: pack_chance of packs (at least min_packs) are sketched. Each pack needs `colours` status colours (+1 at Rot >= extra_colour_rot or ring >= extra_colour_ring, max max_colours), seeded per pack. A sketch takes no life damage; the right status (from any source) fills its colour, and every hit or DoT tick also adds to a neutral raw fill (damage it would have taken / max life); raw_fill reached = painted. Painted by colour: loot as one rank higher (normal -> elite rolls, elite -> + elite_rarity_bonus) and dust Pigment Dust (elites x elite_dust). Painted by raw fill: rank-up loot only.

wager._doc: Endgame Phase 2D: the Collector stands in a mid-depth chamber. Interact to see `offers` bets (seeded per run, only bets the zone supports). One bet per zone. The stake (gold) = round(stake_per_level x zone level) x stake multiplier and is taken when you accept. Win: gold back = stake x (1 + odds) x (1 + rot_bonus x Rot), plus materials_per_mult x mult random materials, flakes_per_mult x mult Glaze Flakes, dust_per_mult x mult Pigment Dust, and at 3x a rare item at +rare_rarity rarity. Loss (condition broken, time out, death, or the zone boss dying first for 'next elite'/'count' bets): the stake is gone. Placeholders in text: {time} {count} {skills} {life}. boss_rush time = base_time + per_chamber x chambers from the Collector to the boss arena. Phase D2 (re-tuned with typical bots to ~60% wins and +15% expected gold, docs/PHASE_D2_MEASUREMENTS.md; was Phase 2E: bot-tuned to ~60% Competent wins where a bet has a number to tune; odds set for about +15% expected gold): Unscathed allows max_hits hits; Frenzy is only offered with min_monsters monsters in the chambers from the Collector onward (Unscathed needs an elite there); Archaeology and Colourist are timed (count bets with a `time` lose when it runs out); Archaeology is refused once no sealed vault is left. Abstinence (~87%) and Economy of Means (1 skill, ~93%) have no number to tune and pay low odds instead.

vault._doc: Endgame Phase 2D: `count` vaults per zone (+1 at ring >= extra_ring or Rot >= extra_rot, max max). Each is a pocket (pocket x pocket cells) carved into solid rock behind a chamber wall, reached by a mouth (mouth cells deep, 2 wide) sealed by a shimmering wall. The wall is an object with `life` base life (scaled like a monster of the zone level and Rot); destroying it opens the vault. Type seeded per vault by weight (the plaque shows it). Treasure: a cache. Trap: `trap.elites` elites + a pack inside, aggro, loot x trap.loot_mult; the cache drops when the last trap monster dies. Riddle: `riddle.sigils` sigils in the pocket, strike them in the plaque's order; a wrong sigil resets the order and wakes riddle.wrong_pack monsters; solved = the cache + riddle.bonus_rares rares. Every opened vault also rolls a Ground Shard of the ring's layer at shard_chance + shard_rot_bonus x Rot. Vaults opened after the boss dies still pay out but do not count for contracts.

types.name: Trap
types.desc: An elite ambush; its monsters drop double loot, then a cache.

types.name: Riddle
types.desc: Strike the sigils in the order on the plaque for a richer cache.

burning._doc: Endgame Phase 3C (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE3.md, Stage 3C): the Burning Canvas. The fire front is a distance along the zone's floor from the entrance (4-way flood fill, so it follows the corridors and never jumps chambers). It starts `grace` s after you enter, at speed = (distance from the entrance to the arena) / arena_time cells per second x speed_mult, +kill_speed per kill (zone kills) up to +kill_cap. pause_at_boss (default off): the front stands still while the boss is awake. It stops for good when the boss dies (Last Light: the last wave). Behind the front (burnt floor): items of burn_rarities and gold on the ground burn (rares and better, gems, materials are safe); standing there deals fire damage per second = dot_pct x (ref_life_base + ref_life_per_level x zone level) x dot_mult, reduced by fire resistance, in dot_tick steps. Monsters take none. Ash: a non-elite kill drops 1 at ash_chance, an elite elite_ash (+1 at elite_ash_extra), the boss boss_ash; kills within ahead_cells ahead of the front drop x ahead_mult; all x ash_mult (seeded rounding). Cisterns: `cisterns` (+rot_cisterns at Rot >= 1, at least 1) in normal chambers nearest cistern_at x the arena distance (the Rot one at rot_cistern_at), never in the arena. Interact: a channel of `channel` s (cancelled by a hit of interrupt_pct of max life or by walking away); then the front goes back push_frac x the arena distance (never behind the entrance) and holds still for `hold` s. One use each. Pigment modifiers: grace / ahead_mult / cisterns / elite_ash / rarity add, speed_mult / dot_mult / ash_mult multiply. 3C bot measurements (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE3.md): arena_time 250 = typical bots at ring 3 never caught by the front in 80% (Rot 0) / 73% (Rot 3) of runs; typical Ash per run 45 (Rot 0) / 61 (Rot 3), so the Ash Pigment costs 240 (~4.5 runs) and the Wells Pigment half that.

wells._doc: Endgame Phase 3C (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE3.md, Stage 3C): Pigment Wells. `count` [2, 3] wells (seeded, 50/50; min_count from a Pigment), each in a different normal chamber spread by depth (never the entrance or the arena), colours seeded from `colours` (no repeats). The Atelier's Umber Well adds a 4th, umber well. Fill 0..1: a kill in the well's chamber or within radius_cells adds kill_fill (elites and minibosses elite_fill) x kill_fill_mult x fill_mult; standing within near_cells adds time_fill per second x time_fill_mult x fill_mult. No fill after the boss dies. Danger: monsters in a well's chamber get its colour's effect x fill x danger_mult: crimson +fire x their damage as added fire and an ignite chance (%), ochre +armour more armour, verdigris a poison chance (%). The mix (the easel in the arena after the boss): draws = the sum of the colour fills (umber excluded), rounded, at least 1 if anything filled, + 1 per rot_draws_per Rot, + draws (Pigment). Shares = fill / total. Balanced: with 3 colour wells no share over balanced_3, with 2 the shares within balanced_2 of each other: draws cycle through the colours, + a legendary at legendary + legendary_per_fill x (total - 1) (max legendary_max). Pure (a share >= pure_share): every draw from that colour. Otherwise mixed: the dominant colour's draws + 1 from the second. Umber: its fill is the chance of a unique usable at the zone level (1.0 = sure). Tables: crimson a rare weapon / off-hand with at least one offensive affix (first draw at +first_rarity rarity); ochre gold_per_level x zone level gold, `materials` random crafting materials, flakes Flakes, dust Dust and ash Ash; verdigris a rare ring / amulet / belt / charm (item_w) or a gem (gem_w). chest_rarity (Pigment) adds rarity to every item. Leaving without mixing forfeits the chest (the exit portal warns once).

pigments._doc: Endgame Phase 1E: Pigments (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE1.md). Crafted at the Easel from the mechanic's own material; kept in atlas.pigments (stock) and atlas.easel (slotted, in order). Each slotted Pigment that fits the zone's slot count guarantees its mechanic, adds its modifier and `reward`% quantity/rarity/XP, and spends 1 charge on entering; a death in the zone spends death_charges more. Slots: `slots` base, +1 in rings >= extra_slot_ring or a Restored region, + the Atelier (Phase 3B: The Third Colour +1, Binding Varnish caps at 1), max max_slots (3; the 3rd slot only comes from the Atelier). The Easel holds easel_slots Pigments (+1 with The Third Colour). A modifier is seeded per craft (atlas seed + craft count); the same modifier twice stacks.

atelier._doc: Endgame Phase 3B: the Atelier (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE3.md), the choice-based board that replaced the Varnish slots. Per character (atlas.atelier = {taken: [node ids], choices: {node id: option id}}). Points are computed from the atlas, never stored: points.region per first clear of a region in ring >= points.region_min_ring (max points.region_cap) + points.warden per Layer Warden's first kill (+ the Bare Canvas choice b's extra). 6 wedges x 6 nodes: 3 small, 1 choice (pick 1 of `options`), 1 notable, 1 tip (rule-changer); `costs` by kind. Path: the smalls are open from the hub in any order, the choice needs `choice_needs` smalls of its wedge, the notable needs the choice, the tip the notable. Free respec; a single node can be refunded when nothing taken needs it and the points still cover the rest. Nodes edit zone parameters only, never character stats. `fx` keys and how they combine are documented in fx_doc; AtlasRules.atelier_fx(st) is the single source of zone-rule effects. `needs_3c` nodes / options are shown but cannot be taken until Phase 3C. The old Varnish ids map to their nodes in varnish_map (save v7 migration, smartbot --varnish).

last_light._doc: Bare Canvas tip (Dan, 2026-11-11). Ordinary zone bosses (not Hearts of Rot, not Wardens) are replaced: entering the arena starts `waves` waves (+ the Craquelure choice b's last_chamber_packs). A wave is a pack of `elites` elites + pack_size normals from the zone pool; the next wave comes when `next_at` monsters or fewer of the current one are alive. The first elite of a wave is a Lantern-bearer: life x `leader_life`, +`leader_mods` elite modifiers (1 boss-like + 1 as the node's cost), level + `leader_level`; it drops `leader_rares` rares and counts as a boss for contracts (boss time per wave). The last kill of the last wave is the zone's boss death (clear, Rot spread, shard, Guild, tier loot, exit). Waves are never sketches. The Wager does not offer `no_bets` there.
last_light.name: Lantern-bearer

fixative._doc: Endgame 2B. Blacksmith craft 'Apply Fixative': lowers an item's crafting corruption by `reduce` (never below 0). At most `max_uses` per item (item field `fixative`). Refused at 100% (sealed) and on Abyssal-Brand corrupted items. Exempt from the corruption roll. Cost: `flakes` Glaze Flakes + gold_base + gold_per_ilvl x item level.

rot_touched._doc: Endgame 2B. Item drops in an Atlas zone at Rot 4+ may be Rot-touched: one extra implicit (item field `rot_implicit` {id, tier, mods}) with a bonus and a drawback. chance by Rot level; tier 1 at Rot 4, tier 2 at Rot 5. Each pool entry: tiers[t-1] = [bonus min, bonus max, drawback]; bonus/drawback = {stat, type}. Own seeded stream; never rolled outside Atlas Rot zones.

guild._doc: Endgame Phase 2C: the Commission Board and the Restorers' Guild (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE2.md). A hub NPC holds `slots` contracts (+1 at rank 4). Contracts progress only from completed Atlas zones (credited when the zone boss dies; the Heart choice is credited when made). A completed contract pays rep (reputation) and seals at once; its slot shows done until the board refreshes every `refresh_every` completed zones (done contracts replaced, `rerolls` free rerolls and the vendor limit reset). Contract rewards: rep = round(rep x need + rep_base), seals = max(1, round(seals x need + seals_base)). `cache_cost` Seals open one of the `cache_offer` caches on offer (+1 at rank 4), seeded per cache opened. Ranks are reached by total reputation; `unlocks`: board, vendor (Pigments for gold, `per_refresh` per refresh), fixative (the Blacksmith's Apply Fixative), slot4, cache4. State: atlas.guild (per character).

wardens._doc: Endgame Phase 2A: Layer Wardens (docs/ENDGAME_PHASE2.md). Each ring has a Warden: an upgraded existing boss. Clearing a region of that ring can drop a Ground Shard of its layer (kept in atlas.shards, per ring). With `summon_cost` shards the player summons the Warden at any cleared region of that ring (atlas.summons); the next run there fights the Warden instead of the hex boss (no Heart). Shards are spent only on victory. A Warden kill drops a Ground Pigment of its layer: always on the first kill, then `ground_chance`, guaranteed after `ground_pity` dry kills. The first kill of each Warden also gives +1 passive point. Ground Pigments are banked for the pinnacle (any `pinnacle_need` of 6 layers, Phase 3). Phase 3A: Wardens of rings 4-6 (Iron Penitent, Malgrath, Stormheart); pattern options `pool` (mortar/eruption leave lingering pools: life s, radius, tick s, mult of the boss hit, status) and `line` / `cross` (eruption: a sweeping line from the boss through the target; cross adds the perpendicular line). Rings 4-6 numbers are starting values for 3E. Phase D2: ring damage_mult tuned so a typical bot wins ~60% of Rot 5 Warden runs (ring 2 0.4, ring 3 1.1; ring 1 never has Rot).

final_phase.message: The varnish cracks - Sir Morcant hardens!

rings.title: the Craquelure Warden
rings.desc: The Gravemaw, living in the cracks. Fault lines split the floor; falling flakes at 25% life.

final_phase.message: The ground splits beneath the Gravemaw!

rings.title: the Pentimento Warden
rings.desc: Archon Velis, painted over and painted again. Underpainting spirals and ghost sigils; peels back her image at 15% life.

final_phase.message: Velis peels back her own image!

rings.title: the Underpainting Warden
rings.desc: The Iron Penitent, blocked in with dead colour. Umber blots pool and slow; the underwash sweeps the floor at 30% life.

final_phase.message: The underpainting bleeds through - the Penitent darkens!

rings.title: the Drawing Warden
rings.desc: Malgrath, sketched in charcoal. Contour lines sweep across the arena; at 30% life he cross-hatches them.

rings.title: the Bare Canvas Warden
rings.desc: Stormheart, primed white. Gesso strikes leave blank, burning canvas; at 25% life the gesso spreads further and lasts longer.

final_phase.message: The canvas is bare - Stormheart primes the world white!
